title: Some polynomial classes for the acyclic orientation with parity constraint problem
summary: We study the problem of finding an acyclic orientation of an undirected graph with constrained in-degree parities specified by a subset T of vertices. An orientation is called T -odd if a vertex v has odd in-degree if and only if v P T . While the unconstrained parity orientation problem is polynomial (Chevalier et al. (1983)), imposing acyclicity makes it more challenging, and its complexity remains an open question.
